title: Immunofluorescence Detection and Quantitative Analysis of pH-Dependent Transcriptional Condensates
author: Wu, Raghunathan, et al.
materials:
Timing: 11–12 days
1.Prepare complete L929 growth medium. In a sterile biosafety hood, per 500 mL standard RPMI base medium (Sigma Aldrich, Cat# R0883), supplement with the following reagents:a.Add 50 mL Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS).b.Add 5 mL L-Glutamine (200mM stock).c.Add 5 mL Sodium pyruvate (100mM stock).d.Add 5 mL penicillin-streptomycin (Pen/Strep).e.Add 5 mL HEPES, pH 7.4 (1M stock).

steps.title: Prepare L929 growth medium
steps.instruction: In a sterile biosafety hood, make 500 mL of RPMI base medium (Sigma‑Aldrich Cat# R0883) and supplement with 50 mL FBS, 5 mL 200 mM L‑Glutamine, 5 mL 100 mM sodium pyruvate, 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin, and 5 mL 1 M HEPES pH 7.4.

steps.title: Thaw and seed L929 fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Briefly thaw L929 cells in a 37 °C water bath, wash off freezing medium with 10 mL pre‑warmed L929 growth medium, and seed 5 × 10⁶ cells into a T175 flask containing 35 mL of the prepared medium.

steps.title: Grow L929 to confluency
steps.instruction: Incubate the flask at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until the culture reaches 100 % confluency (approximately 2 days).

steps.title: Passage L929 cells
steps.instruction: When confluent, wash once with 15 mL 1× PBS, detach with 0.05 % Trypsin, spin at 500 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet and reseed 1.5 × 10⁶ cells per new T175 flask in 34 mL RPMI complete medium (≈1:17 split).

steps.title: Incubate to mosaic confluency
steps.instruction: Monitor cultures daily; when “mosaic confluency” appears, continue incubation for an additional 10–11 days.

steps.title: Collect and filter conditioned medium
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant, filter through a 0.22 µm vacuum filtration unit, aliquot, and store at –80 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare macrophage growth medium (MGM)
steps.instruction: In a sterile hood, per 500 mL RPMI without sodium bicarbonate (Sigma‑Aldrich Cat# R7388), add 50 mL FBS, 5 mL 200 mM L‑Glutamine, 5 mL 100 mM sodium pyruvate, 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin, 1.75 µL 2‑Mercaptoethanol (to 50 µM final), and 5 mL 1 M HEPES pH 7.4 (final HEPES ≈30 mM). Store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Add L929‑conditioned to MGM
steps.instruction: Thaw L929‑conditioned medium, then add 30 mL of it to 100 mL of the complete RPMI prepared above; mix gently by inversion (resulting MGM contains ≈5.4 mM NaHCO₃).

steps.title: Adjust MGM pH to target values
steps.instruction: Equilibrate each 3 mL aliquot of MGM in a 5 % CO₂ incubator (37 °C) for ≥1 h before measuring. For pH 7.4, bring NaHCO₃ to 30 mM then adjust with 1 N NaOH; for pH 6.5, add ~1 : 100 volume of 1 N HCl; for pH 6.0, add ~1 : 90 volume of 1 N HCl. Verify pH after equilibration; perform all steps except measurement in a sterile hood.

steps.title: Isolate bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Euthanize a C57BL/6 mouse, cut off hind legs above the pelvic‑hip joint, remove muscles, excise femur and tibia, trim epiphyses, flush marrow with a 23 G needle onto a 70 µm nylon strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube, lyse erythrocytes with ACK buffer for 3 min, then resuspend cells in 30 mL standard MGM.

steps.title: Plate bone marrow cells (Day 0)
steps.instruction: Place the resuspended bone‑marrow cells into a 15 cm tissue‑culture‑treated dish containing 30 mL MGM and incubate overnight at 37 °C, humidified 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Differentiate BM cells to BMDMs (Day 1‑7)
steps.instruction: Day 1: collect floating cells and plate ~1/5 of the mouse’s BM cells in a non‑tissue‑culture‑treated 15 cm dish with 20 mL pre‑warmed MGM; maintain at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Day 4: add 15 mL MGM to each dish. Continue culture for a total of 6–7 days; mature BMDMs (2–3 × 10⁷ per 15 cm plate) will be adherent.

steps.title: Coat coverslips with gelatin
steps.instruction: Place glass coverslips in a 24‑well plate, add 300 µL 75 % ethanol per well and incubate 30 s, discard ethanol, air‑dry 3–5 min, add 300 µL 0.1 % gelatin solution, incubate at 37 °C for 15 min, remove gelatin, and store coated plates at room temperature or 4 °C until use. Perform all steps in a sterile hood.

steps.title: Preprocess images in FIJI
steps.instruction: Open confocal or STED image stacks in FIJI, adjust contrast, subtract background, and generate a 2‑D projection of Z‑stacks for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Quantify BRD4 condensates in CellProfiler
steps.instruction: Load the preprocessed 2‑D images into CellProfiler, use the custom ExampleSpeckles.cppipe pipeline to identify DAPI‑stained nuclei (primary objects) and BRD4 puncta (secondary objects), link puncta to their respective nuclei, and export per‑nucleus metrics (number, area, intensity) as a .csv file.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of condensate data
steps.instruction: Import the .csv files into GraphPad Prism, include data from ≥3 biological replicates and ≥60 nuclei per condition, exclude images with poor focus or segmentation, perform unpaired two‑tailed Student’s t‑tests (p < 0.05 *, p < 0.01 **, p < 0.001 ***), and present results as mean ± SEM.
